Context: 21. Ex gratia Pension/Family Pension to CPF Retirees

| A. B. | Widows and dependent children of the deceased CPF beneficiary | | 645 |
| | Those retired | Group 'A' service | 3,000 |
| | prior to 1-1--198'6 | Group 'B' service | 1,000 |
| | | Group 'C' service | 750 |
| | | Group 'D' service | 650 |  
Dearness ex gratia equal to 50% of the enhanced amount of ex gratia and Dearness Relief, as notified from time to time, on the sums of enhanced amounts of ex gratria and dearness ex gratia shall also be admissible to them. - OM, dated 28-6-2013.
